title.zh: Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint
title.en: Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint

current_state.zh: PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, a ternary-weight LLM using 1.76 effective bits per weight that claims near-lossless compression in a 9x smaller footprint, distributed as GGUFs requiring a custom llama.cpp fork.
current_state.en: PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, a ternary-weight LLM using 1.76 effective bits per weight that claims near-lossless compression in a 9x smaller footprint, distributed as GGUFs requiring a custom llama.cpp fork.
